item.title: View Cluster Overview Information
item.description: This section describes how to view the overview information of a cluster. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Cluster Settings View permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Cluster Settings View permissions and enter your cluster. Click Overview in the left navigation pane.
